package.description: A desktop pet that reacts to your AI coding agent sessions in real-time.

en-US.description: A desktop pet that reacts to your AI coding agent sessions in real-time.
en-US.longDescription: Clyde sits on your desktop and reflects what your AI coding agent is doing: thinking when you prompt, typing when tools run, juggling subagents, popping permission bubbles, celebrating on completion, and sleeping when you step away.
en-US.name: Clyde on Desk

zh-CN.description: 一款能够实时响应你的 AI 编程助手会话的桌面宠物。
zh-CN.longDescription: Clyde 坐在你的桌面上，实时反映 AI 编程助手的工作状态：当你输入提示时它在思考，当工具运行时它在打字，协调子代理时它在忙碌，弹出权限请求时它在提醒，任务完成时它在庆祝，你离开时它进入休眠。

package.longDescription: Clyde sits on your desktop and reflects what your AI coding agent is doing: thinking when you prompt, typing when tools run, juggling subagents, popping permission bubbles, celebrating on completion, and sleeping when you step away.
package.name: Clyde on Desk
